{"status": "success", "summary": "Started, really accessed, and stopped a stdlib HTTP service in workspace `work/service-check.B.1`; all steps verified with real commands.

1. **Wrote `service.py`** — python3.13 stdlib `ThreadingHTTPServer` on 127.0.0.1:8765; `GET /health` returns 200 with body exactly `p6-service-ok` (13 B, no trailing newline); other paths 404.
2. **Started in background, non-blocking:** `setsid nohup python3 service.py > service.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &` → printed `serving on http://127.0.0.1:8765 (pid 902)`. In a later tool call `ps -o pid,ppid,stat,etime,cmd -p 902` showed `902 1 Ss ... python3 service.py` (PPID 1 = detached, still alive), so it truly ran as a service rather than blocking the shell.
3. **Real curl access:** `curl -sS -m 5 -D headers.txt -o service.txt -w 'http_code=%{http_code} size_download=%{size_download}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8765/health` → `http_code=200 size_download=13`, exit 0. Headers: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`, `Content-Length: 13`. The downloaded `service.txt` was byte-verified: `printf 'p6-service-ok' | cmp - service.txt` → EXACT_MATCH, 13 bytes, sha256 79cd5fda49217cbebaa4a72e23782d8c53e26cd288b17bfef0e4c7174acf4cf9. The server's own access log recorded `127.0.0.1 - - [27/Sep/2026 05:39:52] "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 -`.
4. **Stopped it:** `kill 902` (SIGTERM; no SIGKILL needed). After stopping: `ps -p 902` empty, `ss -ltnp | grep ':8765'` → NOT LISTENING, and `curl http://127.0.0.1:8765/health` failed with `curl: (7) Failed to connect ... Could not connect to server` (exit 7), confirming the service was really down.

Artifacts: `service.py`, `service.txt` (real response body), `headers.txt`, `service.log`, plus `REPORT.md` documenting the exact commands and outputs.", "evidence": ["service.py — stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer, /health -> 200 'p6-service-ok'", "start cmd: setsid nohup python3 service.py > service.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &  => 'serving on http://127.0.0.1:8765 (pid 902)'", "ps -o pid,ppid,stat,etime,cmd -p 902 => '902 1 Ss 00:02 python3 service.py' (survived into a later tool call, PPID 1)", "curl cmd: curl -sS -m 5 -D headers.txt -o service.txt -w 'http_code=%{http_code} size_download=%{size_download}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8765/health => http_code=200 size_download=13, curl_exit=0", "headers.txt => HTTP/1.1 200 OK / Server: BaseHTTP/0.6 Python/3.13.15 / Content-Length: 13", "service.txt => exactly 'p6-service-ok' (cmp against printf: EXACT_MATCH, 13 bytes, sha256 79cd5fda49217cbebaa4a72e23782d8c53e26cd288b17bfef0e4c7174acf4cf9)", "service.log => '127.0.0.1 - - [27/Sep/2026 05:39:52] "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 -'", "stop cmd: kill 902; then ps -p 902 empty, ss -ltnp no ':8765' listener, curl exit 7 'Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1:8765'", "REPORT.md — full command/result log"], "unverified": ["The host clock reports 2026-09-27 (service.log / Date header) whereas the stated today's date is 2026-09-24; I did not reconcile that discrepancy.", "pgrep -af 'service.py' also matches the tool's own bash wrapper, so its output alone is not proof; process proof used ps -p 902 and ss instead."]}
